content: Ughome nhyono
Nhwalo Kilichitu akang'ahike kiyegha na mangota hele mipalwa ghughakengama matyangilo ghake, nhwalo mundo anda ang'ahike kiyegha ipalwa alekane na uhakaho.
Kutumbulii ngohe kwa utamo ghuhighalike kwa kutama kwino pannema pano, mipalwa kulongochwa ngita chaipala Chapanga na chi kutama kwa kunkengemii tama mbajha jha kimundo.

Kipinde chikipetita, machiko ghamahele nhengita ilebhe ngita ibhatehila bhando bhangaumanya Chapanga. Ntamita kwa kupala kukihanga na kukipala mabhene na kulobhela na bhulo na ntamita mukuhenga ngongola, kulobhela, kulobhela kwa kupetecha na kuhenga ilebhe ya hone na kuijhinamii inyagho.
Ngohe bhando bheniya bhangaumanya Chapanga bhitenda kukangacha pibhannolekeya mmijhe pamo na bheniya mu kuhenga mughanganandela gheniya hake ndi nhwalo bhinighingana.
Nambo nabhapalwa kujhanguu ilebhe yenio palonge jha Chapanga, jwakilenganikiye kwahadabuu bhibhabhii ghome na bhubhawile.
Nhwalo gwa Lilobhe lya Mbone lilitangichwa ata kwa bhando bhubhawile, anda bhahadabwilwe muughome gwabhe kiyegha ngita bhange, bhatame kwa nhwalo gwa Chapanga kwa ndela jha Uhuke.
Ntumiche jwaumbone jwa Chapanga
Kujhomoke kwa ilebhe yoha kubhandikile, bhahe, ntamangane maha, nkeluwa mukunnyopa Chapanga.
Kuchocha kwa gheniya ghoha mpalane mabhene kwa mabhene kwa mwojho ghoha, nhwalo mapalano ghayekelila ghanganandela twe.
Mpokelane kajhino mabhene kwa mabhene changakokaleka.
Kila mundo pakate jhino ipalwa kukitumii kitoi champeki Chapanga kwajhangatii bhange bhando. Anda ntumiche jwaumbone jwa hupo ya ndela yamahele yapatite na Chapanga.

Mundo jwatangacha pa bhando malobhe ghake ghabhaha malobhe gha Chapanga. Anda apala kuntumikii atumika kwa makakala ghapata kuhumii kwa Chapanga, kwa ilebhe yoha Chapanga alombwe kwa ndela jha Yecho Kilichitu. Nhwalo ung'alicho na makakala ndi ghake machiko ghoha ghangapeta. Amina.
Kung'ahika nhwalo gwa Kilichitu
Makalongo bhango bhinimpahile, makangacha jhe kwa majhighanikilo majhundupaho ghimikongana nako na kulola kubhehe nakongana na kilebhe changachimulika.
Nambo nhwanganila kubhehe mulombana mu mang'ahika gha Kilichitu kupala papakubhujha kabhele mu ung'alicho gwake nhoto kuhanganila hake.
Anda bhinongama kwa nhwalo gwa liina lya Yecho Kilichitu ndi mota kwino nhwalo Uhuke gwa ung'alicho yane Uhuke gwa Chapanga utama nkate jhino.
Angabhe jhe mundo pakate jhino jwang'ahika kwa nhwalo gwa jwaikoma amu likwatulo amu jwatenda ghanganandela amu jwakomanicha bhando.
Nambo anda ming'ahika kwa nhwalo gwa Kilichitu, bhahe, angakola jhe hone, nhwalo mundo ikemwa nkilichitu.
Kwa nhwalo kipinde cha luhadabulo kiikite na kitumbulii kwa bhando bha Chapanga, ndi twenga, bho, kujhomolela kwake nakubhaha bhole kwa bhando bhangajhokanikiya Lilobhe lya Mbone lya Chapanga?
Ngita chighalonge Majhandiko gha Chapanga:

content.text: “Ndi ijhundwipe kwa bhando bhibhabhii na matyangilo ghamaha kughombolelwa,
bhahe, naijhundupa bhole kwa bhando bhangannyopa Chapanga na bhina uhakaho?”

content: Kwa gheniya, bhando bhibhang'ahika kwa kuhenga ghapala Chapanga, bhipalwa bhakibheka pahe jha Npanganwa jwabhe ndi jwakunhobholeka hake, kwa itendwa yabhe yambone ibhahenga.
